title: Week 5 — Baker National
body:
📣 BAKER NATIONAL (Week 5) — All rounds complete! (front + back 9 combined — Summer's underway)

Skins — 6 total, $16.67 each:
    •    Front 9: Simpson (deuce on the par-3 2nd), Archer ×2 (net 3 on 5, net 2.5 on 8)
    •    Back 9: Anderson (net 2 on 11), Mugford (deuce on the par-3 15th), Nelson (net 3.5 on 17)

TOTW: Leadley/Mullins — Net 69 ($50). Their third TOTW of the year. 😳

Low team gross: 80, Oakman/Simpson
High team net: 95, Bower/Petrovskis

🪓 Beatdown of the Season: Mugford 9.5–0.5 over Petrovskis — the most lopsided match anyone has posted all year, and a single conceded half-point away from a perfect 10–0 card. You cannot win by more.
Runner-up rompings: Hopkins 8–2 over Bower and Mullins 8–2 over Heinsch made it a big day for the favorites.

Low gross round: 37, Archer
Low net round: 33.5, Simpson

⚔️ Streak Breaker: Anderson had the low gross round at every course this season... until now. Archer's 37 edged Anderson's 38 by a single stroke to end the reign. By ONE.

🧹 Clean Sweep: Oakman/Simpson took down Gallagher/Fischer with both partners winning, plus the low team gross (80). A tidy afternoon.

Hardest hole: Hole 18 (Par 4, 389 yds) played a brutal +2.25 over par — the closing hole bared its teeth
Easiest hole: Hole 4 (Par 5, 475 yds) played EXACTLY even par — the field feasted on the reachable par 5

🎉 The Fist Pump Heard 'Round the World: Down 8–2 to Hopkins and standing on the hardest hole on the course, Pat Bower rolled in a 10-footer for a double-bogey 6 to halve the 18th — and unleashed a fist pump for the ages. Never let the scoreboard dim the celebration. We salute you, Pat.

Full scorecards + standings: hankhopkins.github.io/sagl

title: Week 3 — Chaska Town
body:
📣 CHASKA TOWN (Week 3) — All rounds complete! (front + back 9 combined)

Skins — 5 total:
    •    Front 9 ($16.67 each): Hopkins ×2 (net on 3, gross on 4), Mugford (net on 2)
    •    Back 9 ($25 each): Nelson (net 3 on the brutal 13th), Oakman (net 3 on 16)

TOTW: A DEAD TIE — Hopkins/Mugford (front) and Oakman/Simpson (back) both posted Net 75. Two different nines, same number. $25 each.

Biggest match victories: 7-3 twice — Leadley over Gallagher, Petrovskis over Heinsch

Low gross round: 38, Anderson
Low net round: 35.5, Fischer

🎯 Three-Peat: Anderson has now posted the low gross round at ALL THREE match play courses — 39 at Edinburgh, 36 at Keller, 38 at Chaska. Unprecedented. Unbothered.

🤝 Deadlock Central: TWO matches ended 5-5 this week — Hopkins-Anderson and Bower-Archer. Match play parity is alive and well.

🐦 The Free Birdie: Bower stuck a gross birdie on hole 10… the one hole on the nine that pays nothing. Thanks, Tom. He tied his match anyway.

🩹 Tough Day Award: Archer/Heinsch — high team net (82). Wesling/Nelson take high gross (94).

Hardest holes: Hole 11 (Par 4, 443 yds) played a monstrous 2.1 over par on the back; Hole 5 (Par 4) played 1.25 over on the front
Easiest hole: Hole 3 (Par 4, 269 yds) played EXACTLY even par — the only hole the field didn't lose to all season

Full scorecards + standings: hankhopkins.github.io/sagl

title: Week 4 — Meadowbrook Scramble
body:
📣 MEADOWBROOK SCRAMBLE (Week 4) — Results are in!

🏆 Scramble Champions: Wesling/Nelson — Net 62.57 (TOTW and $50)

Final Leaderboard (Net):
    1.    Wesling/Nelson — 62.57
    2.    Gallagher/Fischer — 64.96 (low gross, 67)
    3.    Leadley/Mullins — 65.02
    4.    Oakman/Simpson — 68.01
    5.    Anderson/Bornhorst — 69.09
    6.    Archer/Heinsch — 70.27
    7.    Bower/Petrovskis — 74.11
    8.    Hopkins/Mugford — 75.28

Skins — 7 skins, $14.29 each: Gallagher/Fischer ×2 (EAGLE on 1, birdie on 9), Leadley/Mullins ×2 (birdie on 6, EAGLE on 18), Anderson/Bornhorst (EAGLE on 4), Oakman/Simpson (par on 5 — hardest hole on the card, and a par held up), Bower/Petrovskis (deuce on 13)

🦅 Eagle season: THREE team eagles — Gallagher/Fischer on 1, Anderson/Bornhorst on 4, Leadley/Mullins on 18. (No Eagle Pot shares — scramble week doesn't count. Sorry fellas.)

🔪 Skin Snipe: Wesling/Nelson birdied 10 and held a skin for two weeks… until Anderson/Bornhorst matched it in the final round of the week. Won the tournament, lost the skin.

📏 Photo Finish: Second place came down to SIX HUNDREDTHS of a stroke — Gallagher/Fischer 64.96, Leadley/Mullins 65.02. Handicap math giveth and handicap math taketh away.

🩹 Tough Day Award: Hopkins/Mugford — high net (75.28) AND high gross (79). The reigning champs bring up the rear. Commissioner-approved public shaming.

Hardest hole: Hole 5 (Par 4) played 1.0 over par — the only hole to beat the field, even in a scramble
Easiest hole: Hole 1 (Par 5) played 0.75 UNDER par — the field feasted on the opener

Full scorecards + standings: hankhopkins.github.io/sagl

title: Spring Season — Final Wrap
body:
🌺 SPRING SEASON — FINAL WRAP 🌺

Four courses. Twelve match play rounds. One scramble. $1,000+ paid out. Here's how the Spring shook out:

🏆 SPRING CHAMPIONS: Leadley/Mullins — 49.5 pts ($250) Wire-to-wire domination: back-to-back TOTWs at Edinburgh and Keller, a podium finish at the scramble, and Leadley personally went a perfect 3-0 — the only undefeated-untied player in the league.

🥈 Runners-Up: Wesling/Nelson — 43.5 pts ($100) Saved their best for Meadowbrook — the scramble title was the difference-maker in locking up 2nd.

🥉 3rd Place: Gallagher/Fischer vs Anderson/Bornhorst — TIED at 41.5 They never met this Spring, so there's no head-to-head to break it. The tie rides until their Summer Season matchup — winner takes 3rd and the automatic playoff spot that comes with it. A regular-season match with actual playoff stakes. 🍿

📊 SPRING SUPERLATIVES:
    •    Points Leader: Leadley — 21.5 pts (7.17/match). The $100 full-season award runs through him.
    •    The Anderson Season: Low gross round at all three courses (39/36/38), best gross average (37.7), most birdies (3), and the league's ONLY eagle. If he keeps this up, rename the trophy.
    •    Low round honors: Nelson's net 32 at Keller (low net of the Spring); Anderson's 36 (low gross)
    •    Best net average: Leadley, 35.2
    •    Biggest beatdown: Leadley 7.5–2.5 over Bower at Keller — the widest margin of the season
    •    Toughest draw: Oakman faced the stiffest competition, a 35.8 opponent net average every time out
    •    Easiest draw: Fischer got the friendliest slate, a 39.7 opponent net average
    •    Steadiest card: Fewest double bogeys — just 2 apiece for Leadley, Hopkins, Archer & Gallagher
    •    Adventure golf: Most triple+ bogeys — Bornhorst led the way with 5

🏌️ COURSE REPORT CARD:
    •    Toughest track: Edinburgh — 79.4 team net average. It bared its teeth in Week 1.
    •    Most gettable: Keller — 70.7 team net average. The field's happy place.

⛰️ THE THREE TOUGHEST HOLES OF SPRING:
    1    Chaska Town #11 (Par 4, 443 yds) — played +2.1 over par. The hardest hole nobody could solve.
    2    Edinburgh #3 (Par 4, 393 yds) — played +2.0 over. Zero birdies all week; best score was par.
    3    Edinburgh #7 (Par 4, 404 yds) — played +1.9 over. A long par-4 that never gave in.

🎯 THE THREE EASIEST HOLES OF SPRING:
    1    Chaska Town #3 (Par 4, 269 yds) — played EXACTLY even par. The only hole all season the field didn't lose to.
    2    Edinburgh #8 (Par 3, 150 yds) — +0.25 over. A short iron and a good look at birdie.
    3    Edinburgh #12 (Par 5, 515 yds) — +0.25 over. Reachable, and the field took advantage.

💰 SIDE GAME LEDGER:
    •    Skins: 18 individual skins claimed across the match play weeks + 7 team skins at the scramble
    •    💵 Skins Money Leaders: 1) Hopkins — $83   2) Anderson — $57   3) Heinsch & Archer — $50 each
    •    Eagle Pot: One claim — Anderson's hole-out 2 at Keller. The full $200 is his to lose.
    •    TOTW winners: Leadley/Mullins ×2, Wesling/Nelson (scramble), and a Hopkins/Mugford + Oakman/Simpson split at Chaska
    •    League net average: 37.9 across all 16 players

☀️ UP NEXT: Summer Season Clean slate. Same stakes — $250/$100/$50 and three automatic playoff spots. Week 5 tees off at Baker National.

Full scorecards + standings: hankhopkins.github.io/sagl
